comments.author: @JuanitaRichards-c4t
comments.text: I've been there but didn't see any of this, thank God. The friends I stayed with were very protective of me and when we went out they formed a protective guard around me because of the kidnappings of westerners by certain groups.  The first thing I noticed when I arrived at the airport was armed guards all the way from the plane to the terminal and customs and immigration. They had automatics weapons which I had never seen before.  In the airport the people collecting passengers were not allowed inside the airport. They were waiting outside the  glass doors.  One night my friends took me to a nightclub which in itself was fabulous with amazing dancers, but I noticed before people went in they had to drop their guns and machetes etc in  a huge box outside the venue and collected them on their way out.  It was a frightening place and I had never seen such poverty with people begging on the streets and little kids begging on the highway to the airport.  It was so sad......
